name: Automated Lifestyles Hawaii
old_description: In today’s world of technology Home Automation has become the standard for convenient living. Initially know as Smart Home Technology, the use of a centralized control of your home features and devices began back in 1975. In the over 40 years since, smart home technology has developed to almost every room and utility in our homes. The dependable and high-quality devices offer not only convenience, but an unbelievable ease of operation. Home Automation systems are custom programmed to your lifestyle and your schedule. We at Automated Lifestyles Hawaii offering the best and latest technology to easily control everything in your home.
about:
Automated Lifestyles Hawaii operates from Honolulu, Hawaii, serving all the Hawaiian Islands from its design center at 438 Hobron Lane. The company does not disclose its founding year or ownership structure in its public materials, though its online presence carries a 2026 copyright notice.

The firm specializes in total system integration for residential and commercial clients, mastering both high- and low-voltage installations. Its service portfolio spans home automation, home theater design and installation, multi-room audio/video distribution, wired and wireless networking, motorized shading, lighting control, and CCTV/alarm systems. A physical design center allows clients to experience integrated environments before purchase, and the company states it is fully licensed and insured.

Customers include homeowners and businesses across the Hawaiian Islands seeking unified control of entertainment, security, and environmental systems. The company positions itself as a single-source provider for custom electronics integration, eliminating the need for multiple contractors.

Automated Lifestyles Hawaii emphasizes its dual-voltage expertise as a differentiator, enabling end-to-end integration without subcontracting. It offers free in-home consultations and holds a Hawaii contractor license (C-30961).
